digest.greeting: Good morning, Jean. Today is Wednesday, September 2, with 11 calendar blocks, five urgent priorities, eight carried-over items, and no active reminders. Close Amazon Connect Round 1 by EOD, turn Danny's UAT 1.5 questions into a concrete recovery and Round 2 plan, and send Sara the August Rippling hours and PTO totals this morning. The main risk is the 4:00 PM collision between the final UAT session, the CoE touchpoint, and meeting-prep time, with key SaltClick support unavailable for that UAT block. Dashboard state was last modified Friday, so completion status may not reflect changes made since then.

items.label: Close Amazon Connect Round 1 and set the UAT 1.5 recovery plan
items.detail: Recorded completion is uneven across the four groups, with Groups 2 and 3 furthest behind. Before the 4:00 PM final session, answer Danny's questions on untouched scripts, shift-aligned groups, buffer headcount, champions, progress tracking, Thursday-Friday testing time, and first-line technical support. SaltClick has Jacob and Hilary in another working session at 4:00 PM, so confirm coverage and leave a clear go/no-go path toward the proposed September 14 launch.

items.label: Prioritize Licelot's Quality project portfolio
items.detail: Rank the five Quality requests by business impact and set one intake path that fits available PM and PE capacity. Bring the priority recommendation into today's EPMO and portfolio conversations.

items.label: Close the remaining Amazon Connect migration-list gaps
items.detail: Finalize the production list, remaining leaders, and provisioning guidance so the gaps do not carry into Round 2 planning or become launch blockers.

items.label: Update the Sprint 17 plan and clear the DNC scope question
items.detail: Record the decision to defer Biographical Deadlines and keep NTA in Sprint 17, then resolve the remaining DNC scope expansion that is waiting on Frank's response.

items.label: Limpiar Asana con el spreadsheet de Armando
items.detail: Use the noon protected block to reconcile Armando's spreadsheet against Asana, close stale entries, and leave one current operating view.

items.label: Decide Eduanny Suero's SOP access request
items.detail: Confirm the business need and appropriate permission for the Travel Permit client-contact SOP, then approve or decline the outstanding SharePoint request.

items.label: Clear the stalled Sales and Revenue Cloud dependencies
items.detail: Confirm the Revenue Cloud owner, bring Deepak and Tim into the Sales Cloud work, secure an invoice record in sandbox, and set firm due dates.

items.label: Close out the Staff Aug document question
items.detail: Jason confirmed the broad sharing invitation was accidental and should be ignored. Make sure Licelot has the intended access path and knows whether any action remains.

items.label: 10:30 AM-noon - SVC standup and required Spanish self-review training
items.detail: Use the standup to simplify the Round 2 test approach and settle immediate UAT ownership, then attend the Spanish training session; self-reviews open September 14 and are due September 25.

items.label: Noon-2:00 PM - Protected work block
items.detail: Use the cleanest focus window for Sara's August hours report, the UAT recovery brief, and any remaining access decisions.

items.label: 2:00-3:00 PM - EPMO Team Meeting conflicts with English self-review training
items.detail: The morning Spanish session avoids this collision. Bring the Sprint 17 update, portfolio priorities, and named dependency owners to the EPMO meeting.

items.label: 3:00-4:00 PM - Thiago 1:1 and Legal portfolio review
items.detail: Use the Thiago handoff to lock UAT coverage and the 3:30 PM Legal review to surface portfolio decisions before the crowded 4:00 PM block.

items.label: 4:00-5:30 PM - Triple collision across UAT, CoE, and meeting prep
items.detail: Choose coverage before the block begins. Amazon Connect needs a Round 1 close and recovery decision, CoE needs the Sprint 17 direction, and the 4:30 PM Sara 1:1 creates another transition inside the UAT window.

items.label: Send Sara the August hours and PTO totals this morning
items.detail: Pull total Rippling hours for each team member and include August PTO hours. Sara asked for the figures this morning because her report is missing some team members.

items.label: 10:30 AM-noon - Standup, Toggl follow-up, and Armando 1:1
items.detail: Three back-to-back meetings leave no transition time; bring the UAT closeout and the cleaned operating view into the sequence.

items.label: Noon-2:00 PM - Amazon Connect sync followed by protected work time
items.detail: Use the project sync to convert today's Round 1 decision into owners and dates, then protect the 90-minute block for follow-through.

items.label: 2:00-5:00 PM - Firmwide meeting, Laura 1:1, and Tudo Bem weekly meeting
items.detail: The afternoon is meeting-heavy; finish UAT and reporting follow-ups before the 2:00 PM firmwide session.
